name: Carnac
author: Abstract Games factory (game by Emiliano "Wentu" Venturini, 2014, HUCH! & friends)
description: Carnac (Emiliano "Wentu" Venturini, 2014): stand a two-cube megalith on any empty square from the common stock of 28 — and your opponent decides whether to push it over. Every megalith is painted the same: one square end and two opposite long faces in one colour, the other three faces in the other, so standing it shows one square end on a single square, while toppling it lays it flat over two squares that both show one of its long faces — and which colour that is depends on the axis it falls along, not on the colour that was standing. A DOLMEN is an orthogonally-connected group of at least three squares showing one colour, seen from above; whoever ends with the MOST dolmens wins, so letting your own dolmens grow together destroys points. If your opponent declines to topple, you simply place again.
